Aisha (People Ops): Quick announcement: starting 2026-06-01 we're launching a Family Care Stipend pilot and a short refresh to the Travel Code of Conduct. Stipend = $600/year (pre-tax) to help cover childcare, eldercare, or related caregiving costs. Eligible = all full-time employees after 90 days. Apply once per quarter via the Care Portal: https://go.redwood/care-stipend.
Liam K.: Awesome! Is the stipend a lump sum or reimbursements only?
Aisha (People Ops): Reimbursements only for eligible receipts. Submit via expense code `FAMCARE`. Finance will reimburse to your bank on the next payroll cycle.
Sana M.: Any cap on childcare vs eldercare split?
Aisha (People Ops): No category caps in the pilot, but keep receipts reasonable. We'll publish examples and a short FAQ.
Devon P.: Does this stack with existing dependent-care FSA/benefits?
Aisha (People Ops): Yes, this is additive. It does not affect pre-tax benefits. If you use FSA, note reimbursements must not double-claim the same receipt.
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder: Care Stipend pilot signup opens 2026-06-01. Link: https://go.redwood/care-stipend (auto-email and DM for eligible employees).
Aisha (People Ops): On Travel Code update: for company-funded domestic or international travel were adding a 5-minute online acknowledgement on respectful conduct + local laws. Required for trips >48 hours or any customer-facing in-person event. A short violations/resolution flow is linked in the KB.
Security-Bot: Heads up: new travel acknowledgement includes a crypto-wallet reminder for conference swag (don't store keys on work devices). See: https://kb.redwood/travel/security.
Liam K.: Who reviews incident reports if something happens on a trip?
Aisha (People Ops): First contact is People Ops (Aisha). Security and Legal join depending on severity. We also added an anonymous reporting form: https://go.redwood/report-incident.
Sana M.: Could managers pre-approve expenses so employees don't front the cost?
Aisha (People Ops): Managers can request an advance for qualified travel costs via the Travel Advance Form. We'll add the travel advance link to the Care Portal and Travel KB.
Devon P.: Timeline for pilot evaluation?
Aisha (People Ops): Pilot runs 6 months. We'll share usage stats and a short survey at month 3 and at the end. Decisions on scaling by Q4.
PeopleOps-Bot: FYI: People Ops office hours this week 11:00-12:00 PST for questions about the pilot. Drop a slot here: https://cal.redwood/peopleops.
Liam K.: Thanks Aisha, appreciate the clarity.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all 44b Please read the KB and ping me in DM for edge cases.
Sana M.: Noted, will share with my hiring panel for newjoiner onboarding.
Devon P.: :thumbsup:
